description: DieselOBD MASTER_TRAIN_X / MASTER_TEST_X. No time column and no vehicle_id column exist in the files, so replay uses a SYNTHETIC playback clock. Units are INFERRED from value ranges (imperial: degF, psi) because the README's metric units contradict the data; see docs/DATASET_AUDIT.md. MAF and VSS units are unresolved and therefore NOT mapped. DTC columns are vehicle-level tags and are not mapped to per-row diagnoses.
